title.en: xAI's Grok generates explicit deepfakes, triggering multi-country bans and safety backlash
title.zhHans: xAI 的 Grok 生成露骨深度伪造，引发多国封禁和安全反弹

summary.en: In January 2026, xAI's Grok image generator was used to create sexually explicit deepfakes, leading Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines to block access to the service. xAI restricted image generation to paid users on January 9. The incident highlighted the inadequacy of safety measures on frontier image generation models and triggered investigations by Ofcom and other regulators. It became the most prominent AI safety incident of the year, demonstrating that AI-generated deepfake risks remained unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 1 月，xAI 的 Grok 图像生成器被用于制作露骨的色情深度伪造，导致印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾封锁了对该服务的访问。xAI 于 1 月 9 日将图像生成限制为付费用户。该事件突显了前沿图像生成模型安全措施的不足，并引发了 Ofcom 和其他监管机构的调查。它成为当年最突出的 AI 安全事件，展示了 AI 生成的深度伪造风险仍未解决。

narrative.en: The Grok deepfake crisis unfolded rapidly in early January 2026. xAI had launched Grok Imagine in August 2025 with a controversial 'spicy mode' that allowed NSFW content creation. By January 2026, users had exploited this to generate sexually explicit deepfakes of public figures, which spread across social media. The response was swift and international: Indonesia blocked Grok on January 10, Malaysia on January 11, and the Philippines on January 16. xAI initially limited image generation to paid users only, effectively shutting down the free tier that enabled abuse. Ofcom, the UK communications regulator, launched an investigation into X (the platform hosting Grok) on February 3. The bans were gradually lifted later in January and February after xAI implemented additional safeguards. The incident was significant for several reasons. First, it demonstrated that the 'release first, fix later' approach to AI safety had real geopolitical consequences — countries were now willing to block major AI platforms over safety failures. Second, Grok's 'spicy mode' had been a deliberate product choice to differentiate from 'censored' competitors like ChatGPT, and the crisis showed the risks of that strategy. Third, it occurred against a backdrop of growing regulatory scrutiny: the EU AI Act enforcement had begun a year earlier, and California's SB 53 was being implemented. The Grok crisis became a case study cited by advocates for stronger safety requirements in AI image generation.
narrative.zhHans: Grok 深度伪造危机在 2026 年 1 月初迅速展开。xAI 于 2025 年 8 月推出了 Grok Imagine，带有有争议的"辣味模式"，允许创建 NSFW 内容。到 2026 年 1 月，用户利用该功能制作了公众人物的露骨色情深度伪造，并在社交媒体上传播。回应迅速且国际化：印度尼西亚于 1 月 10 日封锁 Grok，马来西亚于 1 月 11 日，菲律宾于 1 月 16 日。xAI 最初将图像生成限制为仅限付费用户，实际上关闭了被滥用的免费层。英国通信监管机构 Ofcom 于 2 月 3 日对 X（托管 Grok 的平台）展开调查。在 xAI 实施额外安全措施后，禁令在 1 月底和 2 月逐渐解除。该事件之所以重要有几个原因。首先，它证明了 AI 安全的"先发布，后修复"方法确实会产生地缘政治后果——各国现在愿意因安全失败而封锁主要 AI 平台。其次，Grok 的"辣味模式"是故意选择的产品差异化策略，以区别于"被审查的"竞争对手如 ChatGPT，而危机显示了该策略的风险。第三，它发生在日益增长的监管审查背景下：欧盟 AI 法案的执行已于一年前开始，加州 SB 53 正在实施中。Grok 危机成为倡导在 AI 图像生成中加强安全要求的倡导者引用的案例研究。

description.en: Demonstrated that frontier AI image generation models still lacked adequate safeguards against deepfake abuse. Multi-country bans showed real geopolitical consequences of AI safety failures. Triggered regulatory investigations (Ofcom). Sparked debate about 'spicy mode' as product strategy.
description.zhHans: 证明了前沿 AI 图像生成模型仍然缺乏针对深度伪造滥用的充分安全措施。多国禁令显示了 AI 安全失败的真实地缘政治后果。触发了监管调查（Ofcom）。引发了关于"辣味模式"作为产品策略的辩论。

text.en: xAI restricted Grok image generation to paid users on January 9, 2026, after the tool was used to create sexually explicit deepfakes, leading to bans in Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines.
text.zhHans: xAI 于 2026 年 1 月 9 日将 Grok 图像生成限制为付费用户，此前该工具被用于制作露骨色情深度伪造，导致印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾将其封禁。

sources.quote: xAI limits use of image generation to paid users following the generation of sexually explicit deepfakes.
